reason: The CIF is valid and chemically coherent: it round-trips as an ordered 40-atom P1 cell (a=5.46634, b=9.46992, c=10.67539 angstrom, beta=99.70917 degrees), reduces to a 20-atom primitive P1 cell with KMg3AlGe3(O5F)2, has full occupancies and charge balance, and has reasonable complete coordination shells and bond-valence sums. Indexing coverage is also strong. However, exact atomic recovery is not sufficiently established: the trace imported the fractional coordinates from the familiar COD 1528141 prototype and refined only metric/profile terms, with no atom-coordinate refinement or independent map. The instantiated-CIF whole-profile fit has RMS 1.289 intensity units (unweighted R-profile about 0.211) versus about 0.14 quiet-region noise and retains material intensity discrepancies, including the 68.90-degree peak (observed 12.67 versus calculated 1.31 on 100-normalized scales). Under the same full-profile comparison the submitted Al/Ge ordering is best, but the next ordering class is only R-profile about 0.226, so the ordering/coordinates are not rejected strongly relative to the much larger model misfit. A coordinate-refined realization with quantitative retesting of the ordering classes remains a concrete materially viable branch.
